courier-relay/protocol-negotiation: courier-relay/protocol-negotiation: Request protocol resolution and error contract. An omitted "protocol" field selects CURRENT_PROTOCOL ("2" as of trial-1y9, the provider's permanently-adopted protocol approved by the integration owner). An explicit protocol value not in the supported set returns {"error": "unsupported_protocol"} (no other fields), matching the style of the existing {"error": "unknown_command"} response for unrecognized commands (inferred-but-reasonable extension of the spec text; established in trial-bk7, unchanged since). Protocol "1" remains supported for explicit requests per the AGENTS.md contract that explicit versions remain supported after a new current version is introduced; SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS is now {"1","2"}. Protocol 1 identifies a delivery by delivery_id alone; protocol 2 identifies a delivery by the (account_id, delivery_id) pair (same delivery_id under a different account is a separate delivery), per the provider's delivery-ID allocation guarantee. Both protocols accept the receipt with the latest occurred_at UTC instant per identity, tie-broken by smallest record_id; response shape ({"protocol", "accepted_count", "duplicate_count"}) is unchanged across protocols. When a future protocol becomes current, add its value to SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS and update CURRENT_PROTOCOL in main.py, keep prior protocol values (and their identity/tie-break rules) supported, and archive the prior version of this record under a historical key (see courier-relay/protocol-negotiation-as-of-trial-bk7 for the pre-protocol-2 state) before overwriting it.
